response.sql: WITH department_counts AS (SELECT ma.department, COUNT(*) AS income_count FROM income AS i JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = i.link_to_member JOIN major AS ma ON ma.major_id = m.link_to_major GROUP BY ma.department), shares AS (SELECT income_count, income_count * 1.0 / SUM(income_count) OVER () AS share FROM department_counts), compared AS (SELECT income_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(income_count) AS combined_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess FROM compared WHERE share > average_share;

assumptions.assumption: Each matched income record counts once for the department of its linked member's major.
